apps.label: Free My TV (home screen)
notes: Syed's own home screen (his fork). NEVER disable, clear or force-stop it. HOME returns here.
Rows of app banners and widgets (date/time). Apps are opened by TV Pilot with launch intents, not by browsing this screen.

apps.label: TCL home / system apps
notes: TCL system and bloat packages: never disable, clear, force-stop or uninstall (Syed's rule). Only read the screen.

apps.label: Google TV home
notes: Disabled on Syed's TCL on purpose (never re-enable or touch it). On the Sony it's the home screen: top tabs For you / Movies / Shows / Apps / Library, search orb at the top left.
Global search lives in Google's apps (Katniss) - TV Pilot doesn't use it, it opens Google Assistant.

apps.label: Google voice search
notes: Google's voice popup. Never modify, disable or uninstall (Syed's rule). TV Pilot only closes its popup with BACK when the user pressed the mic for TV Pilot.

apps.label: Android TV Settings
notes: Settings is a vertical list (Leanback preferences) on the right side; UP/DOWN moves, OK opens, BACK goes up. Text is in the tree.
Open a page directly with its intent; then find the row by its text.

home.looks: A panel on the right with a vertical list of rows (icon + title + summary).
home.focus: UP/DOWN through rows; OK opens; RIGHT on a row with a switch/slider changes it.

apps.label: Inputs (HDMI)
notes: Switch input directly: read the input ids from `dumpsys tv_input` and open content://android.media.tv/passthrough/<input id> (VIEW). HDMI 1/2/3 are matched by label.
Fallback: the TV's Inputs panel lists HDMI 1..4, AV, TV; UP/DOWN and OK.
